frame.notes: Full-screen thin cyan frame. Used on shell panels as the canvas trim. All corners square (0px radius).

cards.notes: Per-widget module frames: thin cyan outline with subtle corner bracket details (HUD tech style applied via pseudo-elements). Each widget section is an independent outlined box. Square corners (0px).

dividers.notes: Thin horizontal dividers between section blocks and between table rows. Very dark teal, no glow.

inputs.notes: The reference has no visible text input fields. The eDEX composer input keeps its default structure but themed with the border color.

activeIndicators.notes: Vertical green active/status bar on the left edge. Color bright green #02fd8a. Applied to the sidebar active item indicator (left accent bar on selected treeitem).

regions.name: topBar
regions.description: Title XRY/B1 (left), ANALYSIS / DNA tag, ANALYSING ... [XXX] status, ACTIVE / XRAY JZX / 05, BLOOD CIRCULATORY SYSTEM, ACTIVE PANELS control strip, timer 00:00:08.750 (right). Y: 0-140px

regions.name: leftBar
regions.description: Left column 480px wide. Top: large circular radar/scan disc with segmented outer ring, concentric rings, crosshair, tick marks, target reticle. Vertical green status bar along left edge. Bottom: 4-column stacked module blocks (energy cells), 2x2 circular knobs, POWER GEN / 252X and CODE / ZX / 01252X labels, small square control blocks. Y: 140-880px

regions.name: center
regions.description: Center region 922px wide. Human body DNA scan figure (cyan skeleton + pink/purple highlights), multi-layer concentric arcs and grids, BODY DNA SCAN arc title (DNA in orange), MEDICAL ANALYSIS BODY / JZX0154 title, SPEED param 7200 (left of figure), ALTITUDE param 1199 (right of figure), bottom horizontal scale bar with time 00:00:00.083, < > nav buttons.

regions.name: rightBar
regions.description: Right column 480px wide. Top: ECG waveform with grid, BPM=100, HEART=112 readouts. Middle: vertical green bar, ALTIT vertical label, value blocks 9400, 8300, 8300, 8300, 9400, 0511. Bottom: curved vertical slide rail, > arrow button, angle reading 157, bottom horizontal scale. Y: 140-880px

regions.name: bottomBar
regions.description: Bottom strip 134px tall. DATA TIMELINE table with columns NO. / DATA TIMELINE / DATA/XG / RESULT / REPORTS / 0215. 3 rows: 0321 JZXO125 R0215 DUFHETKST/0125 0215/RD ERROR (red); 0452 DHA0358 T2156 HOLLETKFS/0158 0215/RD RIGHT (dim); 0598 DTA0489 D1245 LUFTEKKDD/2654 0215/RD DONE (green). Orange header frames, very thin row dividers, X close icons, hamburger menu icon.

keyElements.description: Large circular radar/scan disc with bright cyan segmented outer ring #31F2F0, multiple inner concentric rings (dim teal to dark), crosshair through center, dense tick marks with angle numbers around rim, center target reticle (multi-ring), two side-lobe shadow regions. Subtle cyan glow around outer ring and center. Approximate center: (240, 380) in left column.
ECG/heartbeat waveform with dim grid dots, bright cyan waveform line #00F8F8, BPM=100 label, HEART=112 label. Right column top area ~(1450-1830, 180-350).

Human front-view skeleton/vascular scan figure. Cyan outlines for skeletal frame, pink-purple #9BA1CD / #455173 for internal organ/vascular highlights. Surrounded by multi-layer concentric arcs, radial grids, orbital rings. Arc title BODY DNA SCAN with DNA in orange.

Four columns of vertical stacked short segments (like energy cells or cascade lights). First two columns bright cyan, last two dim. Each column in a thin cyan outline frame with corner details. Located left column bottom, above POWER GEN / 252X and CODE / ZX / 01252X labels. Also pairs of 2x2 circular knobs with concentric rings.

DATA TIMELINE data table spanning full bottom width. Columns: NO., DATA TIMELINE, DATA/XG, RESULT, REPORTS / 0215. Three rows of scan code records. Orange frames around header cells. ERROR in red (#d40202). RIGHT in dim teal. DONE in bright green (#02fd8a). Very thin row dividers. X close icons, + expand icon, > row arrows, hamburger menu icon.
Thin vertical green bar (#02fd8a) at leftmost edge of left column, extends from ~y300 to ~y800. Filled segment from ~y600 to ~y800. Like a signal strength or progress indicator.

reference.name: RADAR
reference.description: Circular radar scan disc with segmented ring, concentric rings, crosshair, tick marks, target reticle, sweep, glow. Signature element of the reference.

reference.name: POWER GEN / CODE
reference.description: Four columns of vertical stacked segment blocks + 2x2 circular knobs + labels POWER GEN / 252X and CODE / ZX / 01252X. Like energy/status meters.

reference.name: ECG / HEART
reference.description: ECG heartbeat waveform with grid, BPM=100 reading, HEART=112 reading. Live vital-sign monitor.

reference.name: ALTIT / STATS
reference.description: Vertical green bar, ALTIT vertical text label, value blocks showing 9400, 8300, 0511, curved slide rail with tick marks, angle reading 157.

reference.name: DATA TIMELINE
reference.description: Full-width data table with NO. / DATA TIMELINE / DATA/XG / RESULT columns + REPORTS header. Orange header frames, scan-code rows with ERROR/RIGHT/DONE status.

matches.notes: No existing eDEX widget counterpart. The circular radar is the signature element - chosen as featured widget to replace the WORLD VIEW globe slot.
The stacked segment columns resemble status gauges/meters similar to the CPU widget's gauge bars. Replace CpuWidget with a reference-styled stacked meter + knobs widget using usePanel CPU data.
The ECG waveform is a live chart similar to the TRAFFIC widget's TX/RX charts. Replace TrafficWidget with an ECG-style waveform widget using useNetwork Tx/Rx history data as the waveform source.
The status value blocks + vertical meter resemble interface status readouts replaced by the NetworkStatusWidget.

The data timeline table is a list/table of rows, similar to the file browser list in the files widget. Replace FilesWidget with a timeline-styled log table using useFiles data (render file entries as timeline rows).

featured.name: RADAR
featured.note: The circular radar scan disc is the reference's signature element with no existing eDEX counterpart. It replaces the WORLD VIEW globe slot in the right bar. Implementation: concentric rings, outer segmented ring, crosshair, center target reticle, and a rotating sweep animation (conic-gradient wedge, 360 deg linear infinite). Glow + tick marks around the rim.
